pokedexEntries.x: It hides in shadows. It is said that if Gengar is hiding, it cools the area by nearly 10 degrees Fahrenheit.

pokedexEntries.y: Hiding in people's shadows at night, it absorbs their heat. The chill it causes makes the victims shake.

pokedexEntries.su: Gengar’s relationships are warped. It has no interest in opponents unless it perceives them as prey.

pokedexEntries.mo: The energy of Mega Evolution awakened it. It sinks into another dimension, where it keeps a patient watch for its chance to attack.

pokedexEntries.us: It tries to take the lives of anyone and everyone. It will even try to curse the Trainer who is its master!

pokedexEntries.um: Mega Evolution has made it possible for Gengar to access other dimensions. Its entire body is brimming with strange power.

pokedexEntries.lgpe: It can pass through other dimensions and can appear anywhere. It caused a stir one time when it stuck just one leg out of a wall.
